1. padding na lateral das sessões - deve haver, atualmente nao esta com eles [home]

1. tvboxandroid - Suggestion — Increase the bottom vertical padding of the pages, as the “You May Like” section is visually too close to the lower page boundary, which impacts layout spacing and overall readability.

2. TvBoxAndroid -  Suggestion — When the focus reaches the end of a section, if the user continues pressing the navigation key (e.g., right), the focus should remain fixed at the last element instead of moving to the section above. The focus should only move when the user explicitly navigates upward using the appropriate input.

3. TV Series Details - The cover images for each episode of a TV series do not appear in the episode image, or at least the series cover image should be the default for the episodes.

4.  [bug]-Player — The series and movies player intermittently freezes during playback.

5.sujestion - chanel = wheen the focuz reaches the last elemnts ( end of a collum) like category or chanels , if the user try to force it pressing to the finished, the focus should stay fixed and do not move to the session above, instead that the usaer moves presseing down in the keyboard

8. [bug] - Channel — When the user navigates to the first or last channel and selects it, the channel starts playing in the mini preview component. If the user then navigates to the preview and presses the Next or Previous channel buttons, the application crashes.
This issue could be resolved by disabling or hiding the Next and Previous buttons when the user reaches the first or last channel, preventing any further navigation beyond the available channel range.

7. [Bug] Channel Player — The channel player is unresponsive and does not register any user interaction. All click actions are ignored, preventing any form of interaction with the player.

8. sujestion -  Configuration — When the language is set to Portuguese, the date format should follow the DD/MM/YYYY standard.
